title: A Taxi Stopped in the Rain. What Happened Next?
context: On the way to Bulguksa Temple, a tourist was waiting for a bus when a sudden storm brought heavy rain. A taxi stopped nearby.
question: What did the taxi do?
reveal: The traveler said the taxi stopped and someone gave them an umbrella. It was only their fourth day visiting South Korea, and the unexpected gesture stayed with them.
insight: Sometimes the most memorable travel moments aren't attractions. They're small, unexpected acts of help.

title: Would You Give Away Your Only Umbrella?
context: A foreigner saw another foreigner running through heavy rain. They were about 200 yards from their own front door and had an umbrella.
question: Would you offer your umbrella, even if it meant getting soaked?
reveal_headline: They tried to pass the kindness on.
reveal: The writer tried to hand over the umbrella, even though they would get wet on the way home. They remembered that someone had once given them an umbrella, too.
insight: One act of kindness can inspire another — even between strangers.
